narrative.overview: Rulebook is an Operate surface: users build, fund, publish, and inspect on-chain automations. The visual system is a dark, precise workspace with a cool neutral ladder, one blue action color, and separate network colors for Reactive Lasna, Unichain Sepolia, and Base Sepolia. Brand expression lives in craft details, not decoration. The landing page is the only Persuade surface and keeps its own photographic world; workspace rules stop at its boundary.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral surface ladder (canvas, surface, raised, inset, control) with bordered tonal panels.
Single accent blue for primary actions, focus rings, active rail edges, and current steps.
Automation lavender and funds mint paired with visible network names and semantic status dots.
Low-light device photography and light action pills isolated to the Persuade landing page.
dos: Do keep network names and status labels beside their colors.
Do show the empty, filled, focus, and invalid states of sentence slots.
Do use bordered, tonal workspace panels and reserve pronounced content shadows for wallet overlays.
Do group rail navigation by Automation, Discover, and Manage; keep the active item on a raised surface with an accent edge.
Do give every page a single clear primary action in its heading.
Do keep transaction identifiers readable at narrow widths.
donts: Don't reuse the active green for fired, paused, cancelled, or unfunded rules.
Don't carry landing-page photo treatments into transaction and account panels.
Don't add raw hex, `oklch()`, `rgb()`, or `hsl()` outside `tokens.css`, except the documented landing files.
Don't add a new `rb-*` class in a page or feature component.
Don't add glass blur, gradients, or glow to workspace cards.
